theme_and_concept.name: Monochrome Editorial
theme_and_concept.description: High-fashion print editorial meets letterpress stationery. A sophisticated, Awwwards-level digital Rakhi card. Strictly black and white.

fonts.usage: Headings, Hero Text, Marquee, Chapter Numbers (Italicized for emphasis)
Body copy, captions, small utility labels, buttons

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[10vw] leading-[0.85] tracking-tighter font-serif font-light
hierarchy.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-sans font-medium

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Asymmetric, heavily utilizing negative space. Avoid center-alignment for body text; favor sharp left-alignments with wide indents (e.g., ml-auto w-2/3) for contrast.

components_blueprint.name: Kinetic Hero
components_blueprint.layout: Min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-center items-start pt-32 pb-16 relative

interactions.text_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal. Wrap each line of 'For Akshita Di' in an overflow-hidden div, and animate the inner text from y: '100%' to 0% using framer-motion with ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] and duration 1.2s.
interactions.3d_envelope: A subtle framer-motion useMotionValue driven 3D tilt effect on a graphic element (like a black rectangle with a thin white border representing a card) floating in the background.

components_blueprint.name: Editorial Marquee
components_blueprint.layout: w-full py-12 border-y border-foreground/10 bg-background overflow-hidden
components_blueprint.interactions: Use react-fast-marquee. Text: 'Happy Raksha Bandhan — Akshita Di —'. Massive font (text-6xl md:text-8xl), serif, very slow speed, purely decorative.

components_blueprint.name: Chapter Manifesto (Heartfelt Messages)
components_blueprint.layout: Grid layout. Left col (col-span-4): Sticky chapter number (01, 02). Right col (col-span-8): The heartfelt message.
components_blueprint.interactions: Scroll-triggered reveal of text (framer-motion whileInView). The chapter number stays sticky top-32 while scrolling past the right-side text.

components_blueprint.name: Gallery Section
components_blueprint.layout: Tetris bento grid. Mix of landscape and portrait frames. col-span-12 md:col-span-8, col-span-4, etc.
components_blueprint.visuals: Spotlight/clipped frames: Images wrapped in divs with 1px black borders, padding (p-2 or p-4 inside the frame), and grayscale filter (grayscale transition-all duration-700 hover:grayscale-0). Use elegant placeholder photos.

components_blueprint.name: Hidden Surprise Reveal
components_blueprint.layout: A circular 'wax seal' style button in the footer or fixed to the side. Text 'DO NOT OPEN' curving around it using SVG textPath.
components_blueprint.interactions: On click, triggers a full-screen Framer Motion overlay (AnimatePresence, height 0 to 100vh) displaying a final secret heartfelt message with elegant typography and a closing signature '— Your Brother'.

components_blueprint.name: Music Toggle
components_blueprint.layout: Fixed bottom-8 right-8 z-50. Circular button, black background, white icon. When playing, the border or an outer dashed ring slowly spins.
components_blueprint.interactions: Toggles HTML5 Audio element. Soft instrumental placeholder.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Implement Lenis smooth scrolling globally in the root layout. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.

textures.usage: Can be used as a subtle noise/texture overlay with mix-blend-mode or low opacity for the hero 3D card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Add the Google Fonts to the global CSS or index.html.
Ensure global layout uses pure black and pure white / very light gray, absolutely NO saturated colors anywhere.
The kinetic text reveal must use `overflow: hidden` on a wrapper for each line, and animate the `motion.span` inside it. This creates the 'mask' effect.
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Wrap the App or main content in a Lenis provider component.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards. Build bespoke, 1px bordered divs with generous internal padding.
Include a `data-testid` on the music toggle, surprise button, and any other interactive elements.
Music can be mocked with an empty audio tag or a free royalty-free classical piano mp3 URL. Add instructions in a comment for the user to swap it.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements, like 'data-testid="music-toggle-button"'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align everything. Leverage left alignments and massive indents.
Add generous padding (p-24 or p-32) instead of standard cramped spacings.
Add subtle micro-interactions on hover (scale, opacity).
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Always apply transitions carefully to specific properties, avoiding 'transition: all' that breaks transforms.
